title: Topic-Level Fairness in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34683v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group fairness in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems is typically evaluated using metrics aggregated across queries. However, such metrics can conceal topic-level disparities: a system may favor women on questions about human rights and men on questions about actors and filmmakers, appearing nearly neutral overall even though neither topic is fair. We therefore study topic-level fairness, which requires group fairness to hold within each topic rather than only in aggregate. To reduce the topic-level disparity, we adapt the reranker separately for each topic with a Bradley-Terry objective under direct supervision from the generated output: preference pairs built from the generator's own output carry the direction that topic requires. With preference pairs built from RoMQA alone, the adaptation reduces the mean absolute per-topic disparity by 51% on RoMQA and by 40% on TREC Fair Ranking while retaining accuracy. No baseline reach

translated_title: 检索增强生成中的主题级公平性
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的群体公平性通常使用跨查询聚合的指标进行评估。然而，这类指标可能掩盖主题层面的差异：一个系统可能在关于人权的问题上偏向女性，而在关于演员和电影制作者的问题上偏向男性，总体上看似几乎中立，但实际上没有任何一个主题是公平的。因此，我们研究主题级公平性，即要求群体公平性在每个主题内部成立，而不仅仅在总体上成立。为了减少主题层面的差异，我们在生成输出的直接监督下，使用Bradley-Terry目标针对每个主题分别调整重排序器：由生成器自身输出构建的偏好对携带了相应主题所需的偏好方向。仅使用从RoMQA构建的偏好对，该适配方法在RoMQA上将每个主题的平均绝对差异降低了51%，在TREC Fair Ranking上降低了40%，同时保持了准确性。
tldr: 该论文提出RAG系统中主题级公平性的新概念，通过基于生成输出直接监督的Bradley-Terry目标对每个主题单独适配重排序器，在保持准确性的同时将主题间群体差异降低40-51%。
